Name: Secret Woods Extra Area
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[left]The cave behind the waterfall will be accessible as soon as the bus is repaired.[/left]
The cave always produces one Iridium Node every day.
Even if you are not good at skull caves or fighting, you can get a small amount of iridium ore every day.
In addition, fishing inside the caves is set up to catch unique fish.
(The fish that can be caught in the vanilla caves are seasonal, etc.)

・[color=#00ff00][size=4]Weed Area[/size][/color]
A random number of weeds are generated each day.
It can be accessed from the top right corner of the extras area.
Initially it is locked, but access will be granted as the greenhouse is repaired.

・[color=#00ff00][size=4]Farming Area[/size][/color]
There is a small space that can be cultivated.
There are tents where you can sleep and finish the day. If you don't need it, you can hide it with ModConfig.
The small area to the right has the potential to spawn seasonal flowers.
It is located to the right of the extra area.



[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]Deep Woods[/url]  is supported.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/url]  is supported.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is supported.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2364]Even More Secret Woods[/url] is supported.

Currently, English, Japanese, French and Russian are supported.
